class.name: OpenXRStationaryReferenceSpaceExtension
class.description: This extension provides the [code]STATIONARY[/code] reference space. Unlike the [code]LOCAL[/code] reference space, the runtime is allowed to redefine the origin of the [code]STATIONARY[/code] space at any time it is determined necessary, without emitting a reference space change event. When the returned identifier from [method get_generation_id] changes, the origin of the space has been redefined. You can select this reference space through the [member ProjectSettings.xr/openxr/reference_space] project setting.

method.name: get_generation_id
method.description: Returns the current generation ID of the [code]STATIONARY[/code] reference space as a UUID string, or an empty string on failure. This value changes whenever the runtime redefines the origin of the space.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this extension is available.
